prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Karajishi, a living sacred lion of Japanese guardian imagery, never a statue or screen painting.
ANATOMY: ONE LIVING powerful LION with exaggerated tightly CURLED MANE, TWO large PROMINENT EYES, FOUR thick muscular LEGS and FOUR enormous clawed PAWS, ONE curled flowing TAIL, ONE head with two long FANGS visible in open protective warning roar [karajishi-c01,karajishi-c02]. Mane is real living coarse fur curling into dense spirals, not stone carvings. No horn, wings, extra tails, ball or cub.
MOMENT: Bound down from a low rock directly toward viewer, front paws spread apart with immense claws extended in a forceful protective landing, back two paws clearly staggered behind, head lowered and large eyes intent; curled mane flies with movement.
POWER: no visible magic documented; sacred guardian authority through anatomy, protective stance and movement [karajishi-c04].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle; lion's head, curled mane, fangs and four strong legs fill square, no invented giant scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm moon shaft rims antique gold fur and spiral mane, deep walnut shadows, ordinary displaced dust and peony petals.
SURFACE: coarse golden curled fur, dark nose, ivory fangs and oversized claws, rough rock and living peony leaves.
SETTING: editorial stone garden filled with living PEONIES, referencing common peony motif and Buddhist guardian context, no temple text or symbolic inscriptions [karajishi-c03,karajishi-c04].
MOOD: reverential awe and formidable guardian power, active and imposing, never evil, cute mascot, ordinary lion, statue or decorative portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Premium painterly brushwork, dark warm walnut and antique gold palette, square composition.
